disposition_rule: dispositions are qualified_enabled or evaluated_not_enabled, both requiring evidence; a conditional may be not_triggered only when its frozen trigger test was executed and false; negative findings are completed experiments

experiments.acceptance_rule: equivalent crash-safety tests pass, transaction counters show batching under saturation, and affected-scenario U95(R) shows material reduction against both references
experiments.controlled_variable: transaction batch shape versus B-unified plus the matching pre-integration source reference
experiments.expected_benefit: fewer transactions per completed directory and lower end-to-end time on saturated workloads
experiments.hypothesis: Batched task claims, child insertion, events and completion updates reduce transaction count and elapsed time without weakening durability.
experiments.rejection_rule: durability regression, unchanged transaction counts on saturated workloads, or no measurable affected-scenario win

experiments.acceptance_rule: sweep recorded with per-level CPU/RSS/FD/IO counters; adopted level meets its profile budget and does not drop durability or coverage
experiments.controlled_variable: listing worker count swept at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 on suitable native hosts
experiments.default_enablement: profile default chosen from sweep evidence
experiments.expected_benefit: throughput-profile wall-time reduction at higher worker counts with resource disclosure
experiments.hypothesis: Listing-worker concurrency has a measurable optimum and the sweep characterizes it.
experiments.rejection_rule: a level exceeding its resource envelope or failing equivalent-work checks is rejected regardless of wall time

experiments.acceptance_rule: zero status/history/untracked/rename counters on identity-only fixtures plus material affected-scenario reduction
experiments.controlled_variable: metadata/detail stage separation versus combined pipeline
experiments.expected_benefit: identity-only runs skip refs/status/history work entirely
experiments.hypothesis: Separating metadata/detail stages avoids unnecessary enrichment work in identity-only discovery.
experiments.rejection_rule: any identity-only run invoking detail-stage work, or no measurable benefit

experiments.acceptance_rule: at most one common-ref enumeration per store/ref epoch on quiescent fixtures with correct per-worktree HEAD/context results
experiments.controlled_variable: common-store ref reuse on versus off on many-linked-worktrees fixtures
experiments.expected_benefit: ref enumeration count proportional to stores, not worktrees
experiments.hypothesis: Enumerating common refs once per physical common store and ref epoch removes duplicated ref work across linked worktrees.
experiments.rejection_rule: duplicated per-worktree common-ref work on quiescent fixtures or incorrect per-worktree context

experiments.acceptance_rule: winner chosen by paired benchmark on dir-heavy and repo-dense fixtures with identical candidate sets
experiments.controlled_variable: candidate naming from enumeration versus per-directory .git preprobe
experiments.default_enablement: winner enabled, loser retained as evidence
experiments.expected_benefit: fewer syscalls per directory on the winning variant
experiments.hypothesis: Enumeration-based candidate naming may beat or lose to a per-directory .git preprobe; the choice is measured, not assumed.
experiments.rejection_rule: variant with worse or inconsistent results, or any candidate-set difference, is rejected

experiments.acceptance_rule: first-committed-result latency improves and complete coverage is unchanged on order-sensitive fixtures
experiments.expected_benefit: earlier first-committed-result latency at equal complete-coverage time
experiments.hypothesis: Catalog/registry/locality-prioritized roots surface likely candidates earlier without certifying absence.
experiments.rejection_rule: any coverage change, fairness regression, or no latency benefit

experiments.acceptance_rule: option comparison recorded against minimal masks and buffer sizes with identical enumeration results
experiments.expected_benefit: lower per-directory cost from the existing qualified reader
experiments.hypothesis: Existing dua-core bulk reader options (attribute masks, buffer sizes, descriptor-relative fencing) have a measured best configuration.
experiments.rejection_rule: options changing enumeration results or failing to improve are rejected
experiments.trigger: always: required tournament experiment on macos

experiments.acceptance_rule: exact candidate-set equality, native APFS qualification, and U95(R_native/reference) <= 0.90 per PERF-NATIVE-PROMOTION for the scope class
experiments.controlled_variable: searchfs variants (.git-only limited, .git plus HEAD complete) versus one bulk walk
experiments.default_enablement: disabled by default until promotion criteria pass
experiments.expected_benefit: volume-scale candidate discovery faster than walking for eligible scopes
experiments.hypothesis: A genuine searchfs volume candidate source may outperform bulk walking for eligible scope classes.
experiments.rejection_rule: any missed/extra candidate, failed qualification, or bound above 0.90 keeps it experimental/disabled
experiments.trigger: always: required tournament experiment on macos-apfs

experiments.acceptance_rule: both measurements recorded with narrow labels; cached paths perform no filesystem/Git probing
experiments.controlled_variable: catalog in-process lookup versus actual CLI lookup (process start, open, lookup, formatting, exit)
experiments.default_enablement: not an enablement toggle; a measurement obligation
experiments.expected_benefit: truthful separation of cached lookup costs for reporting
experiments.hypothesis: Cached lookup cost differs between in-process catalog access and the actual CLI path; both are measured.
experiments.rejection_rule: any probing during cached lookup or missing measurements

experiments.acceptance_rule: reconciled state equals full-rediscovery state with affected-work counters inside frozen bounds
experiments.controlled_variable: incremental dirty-scope reconciliation versus full rediscovery on known mutation sequences
experiments.expected_benefit: incremental cost proportional to affected scopes
experiments.hypothesis: Dirty-scope/dependency reconciliation touches only required scopes versus equivalent full discovery.
experiments.rejection_rule: false fresh negatives, stale positives, or work beyond documented event-gap fallback

experiments.acceptance_rule: integration replay of raw record batches preserves bounds/malformed-record handling and shows material win
experiments.controlled_variable: direct getdents wrapper versus buffered enumeration through the same engine pipeline
experiments.hypothesis: A direct getdents wrapper reduces enumeration overhead on Linux.
experiments.rejection_rule: no profiling trigger, or any malformed-record/bounds regression
experiments.trigger: profiling evidence shows enumeration syscall overhead is material on linux-native

experiments.acceptance_rule: paired benchmark win with unchanged correctness and resource envelopes
experiments.controlled_variable: system allocator versus alternate allocator with identical binaries otherwise
experiments.expected_benefit: lower allocation overhead on discovery hot paths
experiments.hypothesis: An alternate allocator reduces allocation cost on hot paths.
experiments.rejection_rule: no trigger, inconsistent results, or resource growth
experiments.trigger: profiling evidence shows allocator cost is material

experiments.acceptance_rule: paired benchmark win on frozen scenarios with recorded build provenance
experiments.controlled_variable: compiler profile/PGO/LTO settings with recorded toolchain identity
experiments.hypothesis: Compiler profile changes (PGO/LTO) reduce elapsed time.
experiments.rejection_rule: no trigger, non-reproducible builds, or correctness drift
experiments.trigger: profiling evidence shows instruction-level overhead is material after algorithmic work

experiments.acceptance_rule: a new crash/restart contract is frozen and passes; per-directory resumability is not silently replaced
experiments.hypothesis: Coarser subtree leases reduce claim/lease transaction overhead.
experiments.rejection_rule: any loss of per-directory resumability without an explicit accepted contract
experiments.trigger: claim/lease overhead measured as material on saturated workloads

experiments.acceptance_rule: consistency/lifecycle tests pass and memory stays inside profile budgets
experiments.controlled_variable: snapshot-based query versus direct catalog reads
experiments.expected_benefit: faster cached lookups at bounded memory
experiments.hypothesis: A compact immutable query snapshot speeds cached queries.
experiments.rejection_rule: staleness bugs, lifecycle gaps, or no measurable win

experiments.acceptance_rule: the required coverage contract is implemented and qualified; a stopped process never claims complete historical knowledge without it
experiments.default_enablement: disabled unless triggered, implemented, and qualified
experiments.hypothesis: An optional persistent service supplies watcher coverage across process downtime.
experiments.rejection_rule: any unqualified completeness claim or missing lifecycle tests
experiments.trigger: inotify/FSEvents/USN downtime gaps measured as material for declared deployments
